## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-001

**Fields of a SubscriptionList entry**

The Payload of a SubscriptionList DataSetMessage (one subscription) contains the mandatory field TopicPath (String, the subscribed MQTT topic filter) and optionally Interval (UInt32 in ms, default 0) and Config (enumeration NONE_0 or CONF_1, default NONE_0); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource SubscriptionList (REQ-CMP-039).
- Refs: MG 8.3.9, SF-080
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.9-4b78ef6b, MG-8.3.9-625af7da, MG-8.3.9-c59d2078

> The SubscriptionList contains an array of DataSetMessage objects, each representing a subscription. Included are a topic path, an interval for application internal usage, and a configurability statement.
> — MG 8.3.9

> The MQTT topic filter of the subscription, as subscribed at the broker (6 General Requirements on MQTT, 7 Topics Definition).
> — MG 8.3.9

Notes: The TopicPath is a topic filter as subscribed at the broker, wildcards + and # allowed (MG 8.3.9 since SF-080 (a)). Enumeration encoding &lt;name>_&lt;value> per REQ-MSG-031 (OPC UA Part 6 5.4.4).

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-002

**An entry matches its DataSetMessage and its TopicPath**

The DataSetWriterName of an entry is the Source (the asset that holds the subscription) and its WriterGroupName is &lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] derived from the TopicPath – the resource level and, if the TopicPath contains no wildcard in the Filter levels, the Filter levels of the subscribed topic; the resource level of the TopicPath is concrete (neither + nor covered by #). Source and TopicPath identify the entry.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource SubscriptionList (REQ-CMP-039).
- Scope: MG 7.7, MG 8.2.3
- Refs: MG 8.3.9, MG 9.1.9, SF-080
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.9-e5fa793a, MG-9.1.9-55c5621a

> The wildcards + and
> — MG 8.3.9

> The Source of an entry (its DataSetWriterName, the asset holding the subscription – usually the application itself) and its TopicPath identify the entry.
> — MG 8.3.9

> The WriterGroupName of an entry (8.2.3 DataSetMessage) is &lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>]: the resource level of the TopicPath, followed by its Filter levels (7.7 Filter Element) if the TopicPath has Filter levels and they contain no wildcard.
> — MG 8.3.9

> In combination with a ResourceType (7.7 Filter Element) it is possible to get a SubscriptionList filtered for a defined resource. In addition to the ResourceType a Tag can be added, e.g., to address a defined DataSetMessage of the resource Data.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: Combines REQ-TOP-022 (Filter structure), REQ-MSG-023 (DataSetWriterName) and REQ-MSG-025 (WriterGroupName) for the entries; MG 8.3.9 and 8.2.3 since SF-080 (a). Since the C-028 review the statement includes the concrete resource level (the alternative left open in SF-080 (a)), hence draft; the payload checker reports a TopicPath without concrete resource level.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-003

**Interval is a processing interval of the subscriber**

Interval is the minimum time in ms between two computations of received publications by the subscribing application (0 = every publication is processed on arrival); it does not change the publications of the publisher.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource SubscriptionList (REQ-CMP-039).
- Refs: MG 8.3.9, SF-080
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.9-a5461507

> By default, every publication is processed on arrival (Interval = 0).
> — MG 8.3.9

> The subscribing client uses the key Interval to decide if every publication needs to be computed or not.
> — MG 8.3.9

Notes: Wording of MG 8.3.9 corrected by SF-080 (c). Maximum 0xFFFFFFFF ≈ 50 days.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-004

**Config defines whether an entry can be changed or deleted**

Config NONE_0 (default) marks a subscription that can neither be changed nor deleted via Set or Del; CONF_1 marks a freely configurable subscription. A Set or Del of an entry with NONE_0 is rejected with a status Event with EventLevel Bad (e.g. BadNotWritable), as is a Set that changes the Config of an entry: Config is read only and set by the application; an entry created via Set is CONF_1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application offers Set or Del for SubscriptionList.
- Refs: MG 8.3.9, MG 9.1.9, SF-080
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.9-ad2fe906, MG-9.1.9-39acbd89, MG-9.1.9-5a8f1bed

> The configurability of subscriptions is limited to create/delete/not manipulable – depending on implementation and/or technical needs: NONE_0: No configuration possible – the entry can neither be changed nor deleted via Set or Del (9.1.9 SubscriptionList).
> — MG 8.3.9

> The Config of an entry is set by the application; an entry created via Set is freely configurable (CONF_1).
> — MG 8.3.9

> If the Set addresses an entry with Config NONE_0 or changes the Config of an entry, the Set must be rejected and the status Event must have the EventLevel Bad (e.g. BadNotWritable).
> — MG 9.1.9

> If the entry has Config NONE_0, the Del must be rejected and the status Event must have the EventLevel Bad (e.g. BadNotWritable).
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: MG 8.3.9 and 9.1.9 since SF-080 (e); same pattern as REQ-RES-PUBLIST-016 and REQ-CMP-043. Since the C-028 review the statement includes the rejection of a Config change and CONF_1 for entries created via Set (agent addition in the guideline), hence draft.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-005

**SubscriptionList is republished on every change**

Each time a subscription of the application is added, deleted or reconfigured, the application publishes the SubscriptionList again.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource SubscriptionList (REQ-CMP-039).
- Refs: MG 9.1.9
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-a4d38b53

> Each time a DataSetMessage or a list of DataSetMessages is added/deleted/reconfigured, the SubscriptionList must be (re)published.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: After a Del see REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015 (MG 9.1.9 since SF-080 (d)).

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-006

**Republication after a reconfiguration may be partial**

A republication that answers a reconfiguration may contain only the changed entries, with the ReplyTo of the request that triggered the reconfiguration.

- Keyword: MAY
- Levels: L1 MAY · L2 MAY · L3 MAY
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The publication answers a reconfiguration.
- Refs: MG 9.1.9
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-14a2c4e5

> If the publication is a response to a reconfiguration, only the changes along with the ReplyTo from the call that triggered the reconfiguration may be published.
> — MG 9.1.9

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-007

**Get SubscriptionList carries no SubscriptionList object**

A Get SubscriptionList NetworkMessage contains no SubscriptionList DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-2b8924b1

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.9

> A SubscriptionList object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: SubscriptionList has no Query (GL-ADR-020, REQ-QRY-001).

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-008

**Get SubscriptionList is answered with all addressed entries**

A Get SubscriptionList is answered with all entries addressed by the topic – without Source all entries of the application, with Source all entries of that asset, with Source and Filter the entries &lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] – each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to the corresponding Pub topic; for entries with wildcards in the TopicPath, the application evaluates which of them match the request.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The application supports the resource SubscriptionList (REQ-CMP-039).
- Refs: MG 9.1.9
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-07e667ac, MG-9.1.9-50f9f0a0, MG-9.1.9-6f17c63d

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Filter>]] combination Get/SubscriptionList[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>]]], the publication of this information to the Pub/SubscriptionList[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>]]] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.9

> A topic, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/SubscriptionList, must trigger a publication of all available SubscriptionList information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/SubscriptionList.
> — MG 9.1.9

> In case a SubscriptionList objects contains wildcards in the TopicPath, it is in the responsibility of the application to evaluate which SubscriptionList entries matches the request and must be published.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015. A Filter &lt;ResourceType> also addresses the entries &lt;ResourceType>/&lt;Tag> of that resource (MG 9.1.9: "The Filter can be used to request SubscriptionList objects of a specific ResourceType").

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-009

**Pub SubscriptionList carries entries and optionally Pagination**

A Pub SubscriptionList NetworkMessage contains SubscriptionList DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-9318b6dc

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type SubscriptionList and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-002).

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-010

**Set SubscriptionList addresses exactly one entry**

A Set SubscriptionList is sent to Set/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] and its NetworkMessage contains exactly one SubscriptionList DataSetMessage – the complete entry; a TopicPath not yet subscribed by the Source creates a new entry, a known TopicPath reconfigures the entry; several entries cannot be set at once.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, SF-079, SF-080
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-2c8de6d9, MG-9.1.9-a1f2a02e, MG-9.1.9-c60d1703

> In combination with the method Set, the payload contains a single DataSetMessages of type SubscriptionList. A topic with method Set must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.9

> Each publication, using the method Set, must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.9

> Setting multiple DataSetMessages at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Set/SubscriptionList is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.9

> The Set carries the complete entry. If the Source has not subscribed the TopicPath yet, the Set creates a new entry; otherwise it reconfigures the entry with this TopicPath (8.3.9 SubscriptionList).
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: "create new entry or set new behavior" (heading of MG 9.1.9); entry identity per MG 8.3.9 (since SF-080 (a)). Header per REQ-BUS-010.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-011

**Del SubscriptionList addresses exactly one entry**

A Del SubscriptionList is sent to Del/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] and its NetworkMessage contains exactly one SubscriptionList DataSetMessage whose TopicPath identifies the entry to delete; several entries cannot be deleted at once.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, SF-079, SF-080
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-4f0f8bcc, MG-9.1.9-8b34854d, MG-9.1.9-d3f9c5c4, MG-9.1.9-ea18e7e9

> In combination with the method Del, the payload contains a single DataSetMessages of type SubscriptionList. A topic with method Del must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.9

> Each publication, using the method Del must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.9

> Deleting multiple DataSetMessages at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Del/SubscriptionList is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.9

> The Del carries the entry to delete, because several subscriptions can share one Filter; its TopicPath identifies the entry.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: Unlike the Del of ReferenceDesignation, the Del of SubscriptionList carries the entry (MG 9.1.9 since SF-080 (a)). Header per REQ-BUS-010.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-012

**Set and Del SubscriptionList are protected by ACL**

The operator of the Message Bus prevents Set and Del SubscriptionList by unauthorized communication participants via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 9.1.9
- Verification: d8
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-6f5adce0, MG-9.1.9-dec52a37

> To prevent write access by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.1.9

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-013

**Status event after Set and Del SubscriptionList**

After a Set or Del SubscriptionList, the application publishes an Event of the category Status about the command on Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> with the Source of the request topic and the MessageId of the request as ReplyTo – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application offers Set or Del for SubscriptionList.
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, MG 7.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-406fa1d1, MG-9.1.9-adbe848e

> After a Set message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Set command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller. The caller finds the related Event through the ReplyTo, which is equal to the MessageId of its Set request.
> — MG 9.1.9

> After a Del message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Del command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller. The caller finds the related Event through the ReplyTo, which is equal to the MessageId of its Del request.
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: Same obligation as REQ-TOP-014; content per REQ-RES-EVENT-005. Example MG B1.1.9.

**Changed entry is published after a successful Set**

After a successful Set SubscriptionList, the application publishes the new or changed entry to Pub/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] with the ReplyTo of the Set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application

- Refs: MG 9.1.9
- Verification: d7-test

> If setting SubscriptionList was successful, the new SubscriptionList must be published to the Pub/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] topic, according to the settings in PublicationList (8.3.8 PublicationList).

Notes: Read like REQ-RES-PUBLIST-025 (reviewed in C-027). General rule REQ-BUS-006.

## REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015

**Remaining entries are published after a successful Del**

After a successful Del SubscriptionList, the application publishes the remaining entries of the Source and Filter of the Del to Pub/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] with the ReplyTo of the Del; if no entry remains, it publishes nothing.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application offers Del for SubscriptionList and the Del was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1.9, MG 9.1, SF-080
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.9-496d9c32, MG-9.1.9-a9e2a618

> If deleting the entry was successful, the remaining entries of the Source and Filter of the Del must be published to the Pub/SubscriptionList/&lt;Source>/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] topic with the ReplyTo of the Del.
> — MG 9.1.9

> If no entry remains, nothing is published (9.1 Resources).
> — MG 9.1.9

Notes: Consistent with REQ-RES-SUBLIST-005 ("(re)published" on delete), REQ-BUS-007 (nothing after the deletion of a whole object) and REQ-BUS-008 (the changed resource after a partial deletion); MG 9.1.9 since SF-080 (d).
